summary: What's included each month, and how quickly I'll get back to you.
content:
## What's included

- Software updates and security fixes
- Nightly backups, kept for 30 days
- Up to one hour of changes a month, such as hours, new photos or About page updates
- A check that the site is online, around the clock

## How fast I'll respond

| When | Reply |
|---|---|
| Site is down | Within 1 hour, any day |
| Hours or closure changes | Same day, if sent before 3 p.m. on a weekday |
| Everything else | Within 1 business day |

## Not included

New pages, a redesign, and work that goes over your monthly hour. I'll always give you a price before I start.
